parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: IsDefaultRule
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query system rules.

>  This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

>  We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:

*   1: system rule
*   2: user-defined rule

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-container-defense-rule --rule-type 1 --conditions Type=ruleName Value=auto-test-rule-00 --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --lang zh --is-default-rule 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListContainerDefenseRule --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --IsDefaultRule 1 --CurrentPage 1 --Conditions.1.Type ruleName --RuleType 1 --Lang zh --Conditions.1.Value 'auto-test-rule-00'
